subject: Request: Chief sign-off for pilot pricing & tail indemnity change
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin@edgelogic.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Qureshi <samir.qureshi@edgelogic.com>, EdgeLogic Legal <legal@edgelogic.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot SOW questions — liability and pricing

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We got internal approval for the pilot, but Legal pushed back on two items: (1) the indemnity language that extends indemnity obligations beyond the pilot (they want tail coverage removed), and (2) the liability cap — they want a carveout for data breach damages tied to their regulators.

On price, procurement is asking if we can move to a 25% pilot discount for the first three months to make the financials work in their Q4 planning. If Redwood can’t take the tail indemnity out, they will need the pilot to include a phased acceptance with liability limited to fees paid.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can sign the pilot with a narrower indemnity/tail removal and a one-time pilot discount? We’re on a tight calendar — their board reviews pilots next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Erin
Senior PM, EdgeLogic

Attachments: EdgeLogic_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with legal redlines)
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot SOW questions — liability and pricing

Laura / Ben —

Looping you in on EdgeLogic. They’re asking for: 25% pilot discount (3 months) and removal of the tail indemnity in the pilot SOW. Legal redlines attached.

Summary of our constraints:
- Warranty/indemnity: Standard position is customer indemnity limited to third-party IP + gross negligence; we do not usually grant post-contract tail indemnity removal that increases our long-term exposure.
- Liability cap: standard is fees x 12; EdgeLogic’s redline asks for carveouts for regulator fines — we can’t accept open-ended exposure.
- Pricing: Pilot discounts are possible for strategic logos but need approval above $60k ARR equivalent or if net present value dips below threshold.

Ask: Can we get chief-level sign-off to approve a one-off pilot discount and a controlled modification to the indemnity (time-limited pilot clause that terminates liability beyond the pilot period) instead of full tail removal? If Exec prefers, we can offer a reduced pilot cap (fees paid) + stronger data protection controls and SOC evidence.

I’ll attach the redline snapshot and pricing summary.

Thanks — Priyom
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_highlights.png; pricing-summary.xlsx
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot SOW questions — liability and pricing

Priyom —

Thanks for the concise summary. Quick thoughts:
- Pricing: I’m OK with an exception for a 25% pilot discount for 3 months provided we gate it to a signed MSA + SOW and a commitment to a minimum paid pilot spend (so we’re not doing a free proof). Finance needs to sign off on the margin impact; please include that in the deck.
- Indemnity/tail: I am not comfortable removing tail indemnity entirely. Acceptable compromise: add a pilot-specific clause that limits Redwood’s indemnity exposure to pilot fees and explicitly states that any extended commercial engagement resets the indemnity terms to standard MSA language. That gives EdgeLogic the pilot protection they want while capping our risk.
- Liability carveouts: No unlimited exposure for regulatory fines. We should propose a negotiated carveout that treats regulator penalties as consequential and subject to the general liability cap, not an unlimited exemption.

Action for Exec: We’ll need chief sign-off on (A) the 25% limited-time pilot discount, and (B) the modified pilot indemnity clause with explicit limit to pilot fees. If the chief wants, legal can prepare alternate wording with a rolling cap option.

I’ll prepare a one-page for the chief summarizing revenue impact and legal risk. Priyom, can you assemble the numbers?

- Laura
VP, Commercial Operations

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot SOW questions — liability and pricing

LAURA / PRIYOM —

Finance reviewed. Key points:
- The proposed 25% pilot discount across three months reduces MRR by ~22% year-1 equivalent because of our billing profile, but ACV tradeoff is acceptable for a strategic sector entry.
- Condition: discount approval is contingent on (1) minimum pilot invoice of $18,000 and (2) prepayment of month 1. If EdgeLogic won’t prepay, discount drops to 15%.
- We need the SLA in the SOW to be limited during the pilot (best-effort for non-production) to limit uptime/OPEX obligations.

If you want to advance to chief sign-off, I’ll include the three options (no discount / 15% / 25% with prepaid). Please wire the expected ARR uplift in the one-pager.

Ben
Director, Revenue Operations
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot SOW questions — liability and pricing

All —

Thanks for the quick turns. I’ve put together the one-pager for chief review and a suggested exec memo below. Summaries:
- Commercial ask: 25% discount for first three months if EdgeLogic prepays month 1 and signs MSA + SOW. Fallback: 15% if they don’t prepay.
- Legal ask: Pilot indemnity limited to pilot fees (explicit clause), and standard MSA indemnity restores at commercial conversion. Liability cap remains fees x 12; no carveouts for open-ended regulator fines.
- Ops ask: Pilot classified as non-production (best-effort) to limit SLA obligations.

EXEC MEMO DRAFT (for chief):
Subject: One-off approval request — EdgeLogic pilot discount & indemnity carveout
Purpose: Request chief-level sign-off to authorize a one-time commercial exception for a strategic pilot in regulated finance sector.
Business rationale: High-priority logo, material upsell pipeline; board-reviewed pilot with potential to convert to a $650k ARR account within 12 months.
Terms requesting approval: (1) 25% pilot discount for 3 months (prepay month 1), (2) Pilot indemnity limited to fees paid during pilot; MSA indemnity restores on conversion, (3) Pilot classified as non-production (best-effort SLA), (4) Liability cap remains fees x 12 with regulator penalties treated under the cap.
Risks: Increases short-term revenue forgiveness; residual legal exposure limited per clause; Finance has modeled break-even in 18 months.
Recommendation: Approve the 25% discount with prepay condition and accept the pilot indemnity limiter. Legal to circulate final redline.

I’ll route this to the chief now with attachments. If you want different wording or additional risk examples, tell me and I’ll update before routing.

— Priyom
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
